input.prompt: A character model sheet of four small toy-proportioned full-body cartoon characters standing in one row, drawn as 1970s American Saturday-morning TV cartoon characters on cels. Each character must be exactly the same person as in his reference image: the same face, hair, glasses, clothes, colours and prop, now shown full body from the top of the head to the shoes. Left to right: (1) the man from the first reference image: tousled brown hair, eyes half closed with a smug little smile, black suit, black shirt, black tie, black trousers and black shoes; one hand in his trouser pocket, the other hand holding up a shiny gold coin between finger and thumb. (2) the man from the second reference image: curly dark hair, round wire glasses, sunglasses pushed up on his head, cream ribbed turtleneck, long rust-red coat with an orange sun-shaped brooch, dark trousers and brown shoes; hugging his brown leather notebook with coloured tabs to his chest with one arm and giving a small friendly wave with the other hand. (3) the man from the third reference image: short dark hair, a smirk and a sideways glance, black zip jacket over a black t-shirt, black jeans and black boots; holding a small silver toy rocket up high like a trophy. (4) the young man from the fourth reference image: messy black hair, confident half smile, navy blue pilot flight suit with grey harness straps and buckles, black boots; a navy flight helmet with a gold crescent moon tucked under one arm, the other hand giving a two-finger salute. Style: thick even black ink outline, flat opaque cel paint with exactly one hard-edged shadow tone on the right side of each character (light from the top left), a few confident clean lines for each face, toy-like proportions like the small versions of the characters in a cartoon show's opening credits: a big head about one quarter of the total height, a short compact body and short legs, friendly and funny, but each face still clearly the same person as in his reference image, like a page from a TV animation studio model sheet. Not anime, not realistic. All four the same height and the same scale, standing on the same invisible line, feet fully visible, each figure completely inside the frame with margin around it, wide equal empty gaps between them, nothing overlapping. Background: one perfectly flat solid magenta colour (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no floor, no ground line, no cast shadow, no texture. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels.
